cues: Bakers stir mashed ripe fruit into quick-bread batter, then bake it into a fragrant loaf.
A diner orders a sundae with a lengthwise-split fruit, scoops of ice cream, and chocolate sauce.
Vanilla wafers, custard, and sliced fruit are layered in a dish and chilled for a familiar pudding.
Cooks sauté slices in butter and brown sugar, serving the caramelized pieces over pancakes.
At a barbecue, cooks grill peeled halves until marked, then serve them warm with honey.
Cooks dip fruit slices in pancake batter and fry them until golden for a quick sweet treat.
